name: moose-tracker
description: Moose Tracker gives your assistant a real synthesizer and music tracker, not an AI music generator. Your assistant writes notes in a compact text format and Moose Tracker's engine plays them: analog-style and FM synthesis, samples and drum kits, envelopes, filters and effects. It can design its own sounds and compose full songs, and a free, rule-based scorecard (key, sections, length, genre fit across 99 genres, harsh-tone warnings) checks a draft before rendering, so the assistant spends fewer tokens judging its own work. Get WAV sound effects for games and apps (original clicks, taps, toggles, notifications and haptic-friendly UI sounds), Ogg or WAV songs that play once or loop seamlessly, stems, or a browser link. No sign-in; we do not keep your song text.
